words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一都有数学课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: There was a buildup of snow on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶上积聚了大量雪。
words.en: The gradual accumulation or increase of something, especially when leading to a more significant state or event.

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.ex: Children must obey their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须遵守父母的规定。
words.en: To obey means to do what you are told or expected to do according to a rule, law, or someone with authority over you.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.tr: n. 数字；人物；体形；“figure”的复数；
words.ex: The figures show a rise in sales this month.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字显示本月销售额有所上升。
words.en: A figure is a number or a person, especially a well-known one. It can also refer to a shape or form, especially that of a person.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.tr: 短语，大量的细节；许多详细信息
words.ex: He gave a lot of detail about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他提供了关于这个项目的大量细节。
words.en: A large amount of specific information.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The fish swim in the depths of the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海洋的深处游动。
words.en: The depths refer to the distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something, or the quality of being deep; it can also refer to the most intense or extreme part of a state or condition.

words.ex: How deep is the ocean?
words.ex_cn: adv. 海洋有多深？
words.en: Used to ask about the depth of something.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.tr: 疑问短语，用于询问某人或某物的高度，中文意思为“多高”
words.ex: How tall is he?
words.ex_cn: 他有多高？
words.en: To what height or vertical measurement.

words.ex: The children love to see animals at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在动物园看动物。
words.en: Animals are living creatures such as dogs, lions, and dolphins. They are not plants, and they can usually move around and react to their surroundings.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: n. 变化；变革；“change”的复数； v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: The changes in weather affect our mood.
words.ex_cn: 天气的变化影响我们的情绪。
words.en: Changes refer to the act or instance of making or becoming different, or the money returned when the amount given in payment is more than the cost.

words.ex: The war caused great upheavals in the country.
words.ex_cn: 战争给这个国家带来了巨大的动荡。
words.en: Upheavals are sudden, violent changes or disturbances that cause a lot of trouble, confusion, and worry.

words.ex: The child loves a jumping rope.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢跳绳。
words.en: A sudden, energetic movement.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.ex: He is braver than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟更勇敢。
words.en: showing no fear of dangerous or difficult situations.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: This machine produces lower level of output than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器产生的输出量比旧机器低。
words.en: To generate or create a reduced amount or degree of something.

words.ex: I like apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

words.ex: He not only sings but also dances.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅唱歌，而且还跳舞。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something else is also true, in addition to what has just been said.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.tr:
adj. 每周的；
adv. 每周；
words.ex: He gets paid weekly.
words.ex_cn: 他每周领工资。
words.en: Happening or done once a week or every week; a newspaper or magazine that is published once a week.

words.ex: He pays the rent each week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周支付房租。
words.en: Every week; once a week.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: The maingate of the castle is locked at night.
words.ex_cn: 城堡的主门在晚上会锁上。
words.en: A major or principal gate, often the main entrance to a large area.

words.tr:
auxv. 必须；一定要；
n. 必须做的事；必不可少的事物；
words.ex: You must finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is very likely or certain to be true or to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.tr: v. 讲话；发言；“speak”的现在分词； n. 谈话；演讲； adj. 交谈的；
words.ex: He is speaking to his friend on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他正在打电话和朋友讲话。
words.en: The act of talking or making speeches in public.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 很少的兴趣；缺乏兴趣
words.ex: He has little interest in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学没什么兴趣。
words.en: A lack of enthusiasm, attention, or concern for something.

words.ex: He gave a dismissive shrug when she explained her idea.
words.ex_cn: 当她解释自己的想法时，他轻蔑地耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you are dismissive of someone or something, you show that you do not consider them to be important or worth considering.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.tr: v. 挣扎；“struggle”的现在分词； adj. 奋斗的；苦斗的；
words.ex: He is struggling to walk after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后走路很吃力。
words.en: If you are struggling to do something, you are trying hard to do it, but it is difficult.

words.tr: v. 应用；申请；适用；“apply”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 应用的；实用的；
words.ex: He applied the new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他应用了这个新方法来解决问题。
words.en: Applied means relating to or put to practical use, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: v. 使用；利用；“use”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 习惯的；使用过的；二手的；
words.ex: He used a pen to write the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支笔写了这封信。
words.en: Previously owned by someone else; second-hand.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他以喝咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.ex: The party rounded off the year with a big concert.
words.ex_cn: 这场派对以一场大型音乐会圆满结束了这一年。
words.en: To complete or finish something in a satisfactory or perfect way.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.ex: There is not enough water for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 水不够所有人喝。
words.en: An expression used to indicate that the quantity or degree of something does not meet the required or desired level.

words.ex: He has very little money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎没有钱买食物。
words.en: A very small amount or degree of something.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.tr: n. 单词；字；话语；“word”的复数；
words.ex: He learned new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习新单词。
words.en: Words are the basic units of language used to communicate ideas.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: The book is not technical, so it's easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是非技术性的，所以很容易理解。

words.ex: He was tired at first, but lateron he felt better.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始很累，但后来感觉好多了。
words.en: At a subsequent time; in the future.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；有联系的； v. 关联；“relate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This book is related to science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书与科学相关。
words.en: If two or more things are related, there is a connection between them.

words.tr: v. 连接；联系；“link”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two roads are linked by a bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路通过一座桥连接起来。
words.en: Connected or related to something else.

words.tr: n. 停车场车辆（非标准词，通常应为 'parking car' 或 'parked car'）
words.ex: Parkcar is not a real word in English.
words.ex_cn: Parkcar 不是英语中的真实单词。
words.en: To stop a vehicle and leave it in a particular place.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: The cat is close to the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫在盒子旁边。
words.en: Near to someone or something in distance or time.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.tr: n. 损害；障碍；功能障碍；“impairment”的复数
words.ex: The accident caused severe impairments to his vision.
words.ex_cn: 事故严重损害了他的视力。
words.en: Impairments refer to the condition of being damaged or weakened, often used to describe a reduction in function or ability.

words.tr: phrase. 保持活跃；保持活动状态；持续参与
words.ex: He keeps active by walking every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上散步来保持活跃。
words.en: To continue to be physically or mentally active.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 正面影响；积极影响
words.ex: Planting trees has a positive impact on the air.
words.ex_cn: 植树对空气有积极影响。
words.en: A positive impact refers to a beneficial effect or influence that something has on a person, group, or situation, leading to favorable outcomes or improvements.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎没有，几乎一点也没有
words.ex: There are hardly any apples left in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里几乎没有苹果了。
words.en: used to emphasize that there is almost none of something or that something almost never happens

words.tr:
adv. 迅速；
adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.tr: phrase. 很短的一段时间；短暂的时期
words.ex: She completed the project in a short space of time.
words.ex_cn: 她在很短的时间内完成了这个项目。
words.en: A very brief period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 不受季节影响的；非季节性的；全年适用的
words.ex: The plants grow well, not dependent on season.
words.ex_cn: 这些植物生长良好，不依赖季节。
words.en: Not varying or affected by the time of year; occurring or available throughout the year.

words.tr: phrase. 一年中的任何时候
words.ex: You can visit the park any time of year.
words.ex_cn: 你一年四季都可以去公园。
words.en: During any period of the year; not restricted to a specific season.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet gives a low risk of injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以降低受伤的风险。
words.en: A minimal likelihood of being harmed.

words.tr: phrase. 减少受伤的可能性；降低伤害的几率
words.ex: Wearing a helmet gives you less chance of hurting your head.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以降低你头部受伤的可能性。
words.en: A lower possibility of causing injury.

words.tr: v. 激励；激发；“motivate”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her teacher gave her a prize, which was motivating.
words.ex_cn: 她的老师给了她一个奖品，这激励了她。
words.en: If something is motivating, it makes you feel enthusiastic and eager to achieve something.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 信心丧失；失去信任
words.ex: He felt a loss of confidence after failing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试失败后感到自信心丧失。
words.en: A decline in trust or belief in something or someone.

words.w: give up hope and stop believing
words.tr: phrase. 放弃希望，不再相信
words.uk: ɡɪv ʌp həʊp ænd stɒp bɪˈliːvɪŋ
words.us: ɡɪv ʌp hoʊp ænd stɑːp bɪˈliːvɪŋ
words.ex: He gave up hope and stopped believing in magic.
words.ex_cn: 他放弃了希望，不再相信魔法。
words.en: To abandon hope and cease to believe in a positive outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 过多的努力；费力过多
words.ex: He didn't want to spend too much effort on a small task.
words.ex_cn: 他不想在一项小任务上花太多力气。
words.en: Requiring more effort than is reasonable or desirable.

words.ex: He passed the exam after a lot of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他经过大量努力后通过了考试。
words.en: A significant amount of effort or labor.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: adj. 可管理的；可应付的；可处理的；
words.ex: The project is manageable if we work together.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们一起合作，这个项目是可以管理的。
words.en: If you describe something as manageable, you mean that it is easy to control or deal with.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.ex: Ice cream on a hot day is a really nice treat.
words.ex_cn: 在炎热的天气里吃冰淇淋是一种真的很好的治疗。
words.en: A particularly enjoyable or delightful experience or item.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；持续的；长期的
words.ex: This paint is long-lasting and doesn't fade easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种油漆持久不褪色。
words.en: Something that is long-lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a long time.

words.ex: This product is not generally available in stores.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品在商店里一般不提供。
words.en: Not usually accessible or obtainable.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.ex: The storm is extremely dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴极其危险。
words.en: If you describe something as extremely dangerous, you mean that it is very likely to cause harm or death.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr: 短语动词. 花费一大笔钱；代价高昂
words.ex: The new car cost a fortune.
words.ex_cn: 这辆新车花了一大笔钱。
words.en: To cost a fortune means to be very expensive, requiring a large amount of money to purchase or maintain.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: The logo is recognizable even from far away.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志即使从远处也能辨认出来。
words.en: Able to be recognized or identified from previous encounters or knowledge.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.ex: He lived in Japan for several years.
words.ex_cn: 他在日本住了好几年。
words.en: A period of several years, often implying a significant length of time.

words.ex: He works hard year after year.
words.ex_cn: 他年复一年地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens year after year, it happens regularly every year.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.ex: He hardly ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃东西。
words.en: You use hardly to modify a statement when you want to emphasize that it is only a small amount or degree which is true, or that it is not true at all.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.tr: phrase. 依附于；连接到； attaching oneself or something to a person, object, or place
words.ex: The child attaches to his mother when he is scared.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子害怕时，他会依附于母亲。
words.en: To fasten, join, or connect something to something else.

words.ex: He fixes the photo onto the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片固定在墙上。
words.en: To attach or secure something firmly in place.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.ex: He earns 500 dollars per month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月赚500美元。
words.en: used to indicate that something happens, is done, or is paid for each month

words.ex: He pays rent each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付房租。
words.en: Every month; once a month.

words.tr: phrase. +n. 常规的/定期的 小径；常规路线
words.ex: He walks on the regular trails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上走这些常规小径。
words.en: Paths that are used frequently and consistently.

words.tr: phrase. 开辟小径；留下足迹（make trails 的过去式）
words.ex: Hikers made trails through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在森林中开辟了小径。
words.en: Created paths or tracks.

words.tr: 全部参与者；所有参加者
words.ex: All participants received a certificate.
words.ex_cn: 所有参与者都收到了一份证书。
words.en: Every person taking part.

words.ex: Everyone who takes part must follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有参加的人都必须遵守规则。
words.en: All individuals who participate in an activity.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.ex: He will transport luggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他将把行李运到机场。
words.en: To move personal belongings from one place to another.

words.w: take luggage up on a snowmobile
words.tr: 用雪地摩托把行李运上去
words.uk: teɪk ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ʌp ɒn ə ˈsnowˌməʊbaɪl
words.us: teɪk ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ʌp ɑːn ə ˈsnoʊˌmoʊbaɪl
words.ex: They took luggage up on a snowmobile to the cabin.
words.ex_cn: 他们用雪地摩托把行李运到了小木屋。
words.en: To carry baggage upward using a motorized vehicle for snow travel.

words.ex: The weather improves after the rain stops.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后天气变好了。
words.en: Meteorological conditions become better or more favorable.

words.ex: The storms don't last long in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的风暴持续时间不长。
words.en: Severe weather events are of short duration.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的技能；许多技巧
words.ex: He has a lot of skill in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他在弹钢琴方面很有技巧。
words.en: A significant amount of ability or expertise.

words.ex: The experts say the weather will be fine tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 专家们说明天天气会很好。
words.en: An expert is a person who is very skilled at doing something or who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.ex: He stops and rests under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他停下来在树下休息。
words.en: Cease activity temporarily to regain energy.

words.ex: He sits and takes a break after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后坐着休息一下。
words.en: To sit down and rest for a short period of time.

words.ex: The picnic was canceled because of bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 因为坏天气，野餐被取消了。
words.en: Unfavorable weather conditions, typically involving rain, snow, or wind.

words.tr: phrase. 下雪的或刮风的（描述天气状况）
words.ex: It's a snowing or windy day, so stay inside.
words.ex_cn: 今天在下雪或刮风，所以待在室内吧。
words.en: Describing weather conditions that are either snowy or windy.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭的；不营业的；停业的
words.ex: The door is closed.
words.ex_cn: 门是关着的。
words.en: To be shut or not open.

words.ex: The door is not open.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门打不开。
words.en: If something is not open, it is closed or not available for use, entry, or participation.

words.tr: adj. 误导的； v. “mislead”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ad is misleading because it shows fake results.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是误导的，因为它展示了虚假的结果。
words.en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

words.tr: phrase. 不透明的；不清晰的；难以理解的；不公开的
words.ex: The glass is not transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃不透明。
words.en: Clear and easy to understand; not secretive.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯装满了水。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.tr: adj. 无可置疑的；决定性的；
words.ex: The evidence was conclusive.
words.ex_cn: 证据是无可置疑的。
words.en: If something is conclusive, it means that it proves something in a way that is certain and leaves no doubt.

words.tr: n. 结果；成绩；比分；计算的结果；“result”的复数； v. 起因；导致；
words.ex: The results of the test were good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: Results are the outcomes or consequences of actions, events, or processes.

words.tr: n. (调查或研究的）结果；发现；
words.ex: The study's findings show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的结果表明，睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The results of an investigation or research; something that is discovered.

words.tr: adj. 流传甚广的；分布广的；
words.ex: The flu became widespread last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感流传甚广。
words.en: Something that is widespread exists or happens over a large area, or to a great extent.

words.ex: This rule is universally accepted.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则被普遍接受。
words.en: In a way that is done or shared by all people or things in the world or in a particular group.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.tr: phrase. 非强制的；非必修的；非义务的
words.ex: Wearing a uniform is not compulsory in this school.
words.ex_cn: 在这所学校，穿校服不是必须的。
words.en: Not required by law or rule; optional.

words.tr: phrase. 很少的研究；少量的研究
words.ex: He did little research before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前几乎没有做研究。
words.en: A small amount of scientific or academic study conducted on a subject.

words.tr: phrase. 未经协商；未经征求意见
words.ex: He made the decision without consultation.
words.ex_cn: 他未经商量就做出了决定。
words.en: Without seeking prior permission, advice, or input from others.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.tr: phrase. 被引入；被带来；被请来参与
words.ex: The expert was brought in to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 请来了专家来修理这台机器。
words.en: To be introduced or to have someone or something introduced into a situation, especially to help achieve something.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr: 用于被动语态，表示‘被比作……’；常用来比喻某人或某物与另一事物相类似
words.ex: This apple can be compared to an orange.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果可以和橙子相比较。
words.en: To be likened to or considered similar to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 执行类似于...的功能
words.ex: This tool performs a similar function to a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的作用类似于锤子。
words.en: To serve a purpose comparable to that of something else.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr: phrase. 发展运动；推动发展的社会运动
words.ex: The development movement helps poor communities grow.
words.ex_cn: 发展运动帮助贫困社区成长。
words.en: The process of growth and advancement.

words.tr: 短语，作为……的手段；作为……的方法
words.ex: He used his smile as a means of winning people over.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 他用微笑作为赢得人们好感的手段。
words.en: used to indicate the method or instrumentality by which something is done or achieved.

words.tr: 作为……的一种形式（介词短语）
words.ex: She uses drawing as a form of relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 她把绘画作为一种放松的方式。
words.en: in the manner or capacity of something

words.ex: Eating vegetables is almost as important as drinking water.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜几乎和喝水一样重要。
words.en: Nearly of equal significance to.

words.ex: Eating well is nearly as important as sleeping well.
words.ex_cn: 吃得好几乎和睡得好一样重要。
words.en: Almost as significant as something else.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度迅速下降。
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.tr: adj.最大的【形容词big的最高级】
words.ex: This is the biggest apple I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最大的苹果。
words.en: Of the greatest size or extent; largest.

words.ex: This is the largest apple in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 这是篮子里最大的苹果。
words.en: Of considerable or great size or extent.

words.ex: Factories release pollutants into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河流排放污染物。
words.en: Pollutants are substances that make land, water, air, etc., dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The rainwater drains into the street.
words.ex_cn: 雨水排入街道。
words.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it, usually by pouring it away or by allowing it to flow away. If something drains, the liquid flows away from it.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr: adj. 有缺陷的；有故障的；有错误的；
words.ex: The faulty phone keeps turning off.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺陷的手机总是自动关机。
words.en: If you describe something as faulty, you mean that it is not perfect or it has some weaknesses.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: The builder bought new materials for the house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人为房子买了新材料。
words.en: Materials are substances or things used to make or build something, or to provide information or evidence.

words.tr: v. 表现；行动；“act”的现在分词； n. 演戏；演技；
words.ex: He is acting bravely in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中表现得很勇敢。
words.en: Acting is the activity or profession of performing in plays, films, or television productions.

words.tr: phrase. 合作；共同努力；协同工作
words.ex: They work together to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们一起努力完成这个项目。
words.en: To collaborate or cooperate with others in order to achieve a common goal.

words.tr: phrase. 活动的协调；各项活动的协同配合
words.ex: The teacher helps with the coordination of activities in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助协调课堂上的活动。
words.en: The organization and management of tasks or events.

words.tr: 短语动词. 找到钱/时间等；设法腾出资金/时间等
words.ex: We need to find the money to buy new books.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到买新书的钱。
words.en: To manage to obtain the money, time, etc., needed for something.

words.tr:
v. 支付；付出代价；
n. 工资；
words.ex: He will pay for the food tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会支付饭钱。
words.en: If you pay for something which you buy or for a service which you use, you give money to the person who is selling it or providing it.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 增长的；增多的； v. 增加；“increase”的现在分词；
words.ex: The increasing population needs more food.
words.ex_cn: 增长的人口需要更多的食物。
words.en: Becoming greater in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: Please stop disturbing me while I work.
words.ex_cn: 请在我工作时别打扰我。
words.en: Cease causing annoyance or interruption.

words.tr:
n. 喜爱；赞同；
v. 赞成；偏爱；有利于；
words.ex: He has a favour for chocolate ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他特别喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr: adj. 较低的；下游的；“low”的比较级； v. 降低；
words.ex: He sat in the lower row of the theater.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在剧院的较低一排。
words.en: If you lower something, you move it slowly downwards. If you lower something, you make it less in amount, degree, value, or quality.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

words.ex: He took a painkiller for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A painkiller is a drug that reduces or removes physical pain.

words.w: medicine to deal with the pain
words.tr: phrase. 用于缓解疼痛的药物
words.uk: ˈmedɪsɪn tuː diːl wɪð ðə peɪn
words.us: ˈmɛdɪsɪn tuː dil wɪð ðə peɪn
words.ex: He took medicine to deal with the pain.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了药来缓解疼痛。
words.en: A substance used to alleviate physical discomfort.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.ex: He exercises a few times a week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周锻炼几次。
words.en: Occurring or happening on several occasions within a week, indicating regularity.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.ex: He will put it in the market next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月会把它投放到市场。
words.en: Introduce a product for sale to the public.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: Children find amusement in playing games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩游戏时感到快乐。
words.en: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or entertaining.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The museum shows artifacts from different periods in the past.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示了过去不同时期的文物。
words.en: Distinct historical eras or epochs that occurred before the present time.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.tr: 短语动词. 继续进行对话；持续交谈
words.ex: They carry on conversations in English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天用英语进行对话。
words.en: To engage in a conversation with someone.

words.ex: He loves to paint and study art.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢绘画和学习艺术。
words.en: Art consists of paintings, sculpture, and other pictures or objects which are created for people to look at and admire or think deeply about.

words.ex: The museum has many paintings and sculpture.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆有很多绘画和雕塑。
words.en: Paintings and sculpture are forms of visual art that have been used throughout history to express ideas, emotions, and to depict the world around us.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.tr: phrase. 不如……老；没有……年纪大
words.ex: My brother is not as old as my sister.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥没有我姐姐大。
words.en: Younger than; having a more recent origin or age.

words.ex: This book is less recent than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书没有那本新。
words.en: adj. Not as new or as recent as something else.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.tr: phrase. 做详细笔记；做详尽的记录
words.ex: He makes detailed notes in class every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天上课都做详细的笔记。
words.en: Record information with thoroughness and precision.

words.tr: phrase. 把所有的想法写下来
words.ex: Please write down all the ideas.
words.ex_cn: 请把所有的想法写下来。
words.en: To record or note down every idea that comes to mind, typically for brainstorming or planning purposes.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: Please get in touch with me if you have questions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有问题，请与我联系。
words.en: To make contact or communicate with someone.

words.ex: He explained the problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地解释了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, read, or understand.

words.tr: phrase. 遵循时间顺序的模式；按照事件发生的先后顺序进行排列或叙述
words.ex: The story follows a chronological pattern.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事按照时间顺序展开。
words.en: To arrange events or information in the order in which they occurred.

words.tr: phrase. 检查时间安排；核对时机
words.ex: Please check timing before the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始前检查时间。
words.en: Verify or manage the amount of time spent on an activity.

words.ex: The bakery does not overrun its daily bread production.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店不会超出每日的面包产量。
words.en: Not overwhelmed or excessively occupied.

words.tr: phrase. 个人意见；个人观点
words.ex: He shares his personal opinions in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上表达自己的个人观点。
words.en: Personal opinions refer to the views or beliefs held by an individual, which may not be based on facts or evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 自己的观点；个人立场；主观看法
words.ex: He expressed his own viewpoint clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地表达了自己的观点。
words.en: A personal opinion or perspective on a particular issue.

words.ex: The storms caused many disasters last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年的风暴造成了许多灾难。
words.en: A disaster is a sudden event, such as an accident or a natural catastrophe, that causes great damage or loss of life.

words.ex: The storm caused many catastrophes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了许多灾难。
words.en: A catastrophe is an extremely bad event that causes great suffering or destruction.

words.ex: Different cultures have different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 不同的文化有不同的传统。
words.en: The customs, arts, social institutions, and achievements of a particular nation, people, or other social group.

words.ex: Ancient civilisations built great temples.
words.ex_cn: 古代文明建造了伟大的神庙。
words.en: Complex societies with developed social, cultural, and political systems, often marked by advancements in arts and sciences.

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: The town holds ceremonies every year to honor the heroes.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年举行仪式来纪念英雄。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on a special occasion, such as a wedding or a graduation.

words.ex: He follows ancient rites every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都会遵循古老的仪式。
words.en: A rite is a traditional ceremony or ritual, especially one that is associated with a particular religion or culture.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.ex: She kindly helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 她亲切地帮我做作业。
words.en: If someone is kindly, they are friendly and behave in a gentle and caring way.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: To consist of or be composed of.

words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate or split something into parts or groups.

words.ex: The bridge connects with the other side of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接到河的另一边。
words.en: To establish a relationship or communication with someone or something.

words.ex: I associate with him because we share the same hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 我跟他联系是因为我们有相同的爱好。
words.en: to spend time with someone, especially someone that other people disapprove of

words.ex: The storm brought various weather phenomena, like rain, wind, and lightning.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴带来了各种天气现象，比如雨、风和闪电。
words.en: Diverse atmospheric conditions and events.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整夜。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: The clouds are moving slowly across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵正在天空中缓慢移动。
words.en: A visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: The wind and storms broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风和暴风雨把树吹倒了。
words.en: Air movement and severe weather events.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: I recognised my old friend at the station.
words.ex_cn: 我在车站认出了我的老朋友。
words.en: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看到树上有一只鸟。
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The lab is equipped with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 实验室配备了新的电脑。
words.en: To be provided with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The children are playing on the rooftop.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在屋顶上玩耍。
words.en: The top covering of a building, including the material or construction of which it is made.

words.ex: The cat is up on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫在屋顶上。
words.en: On the roof, typically referring to being on top of a building's roof.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: The park is not very far from my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园离我家不远。
words.en: At a short distance from; nearby.

words.ex: He is decorating his new house with paint.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用油漆装修他的新房子。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr: phrase. 进行一些粉刷或贴墙纸的工作
words.ex: He does some painting or wallpapering on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末做一些粉刷或贴墙纸的工作。
words.en: To engage in the activity of applying paint or covering walls with decorative paper.

words.tr: phrase. 简历中一个有价值的要素
words.uk: ə ˈvæljuəbl ˈelɪmənt əv ˌsiː ˈviː
words.us: ə ˈvæljuəbəl ˈɛləmənt əv ˌsi v i
words.ex: Experience is a valuable element of cv.
words.ex_cn: 经验是简历中宝贵的一部分。
words.en: An important component of a curriculum vitae (CV).

words.tr: phrase. 提升就业前景；增强求职机会
words.ex: He took a course to boost employment prospects.
words.ex_cn: 他上了一门课来提高就业前景。
words.en: To improve the chances of getting or keeping a job.

words.tr: phrase. 回忆往昔；怀念过去的时光
words.ex: He likes to remember past times with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢回忆与家人在一起的过去时光。
words.en: To think about or recall events from an earlier period.

words.tr: phrase. 使重返青春；使回想起年轻时代
words.ex: The magic potion took him back to youth.
words.ex_cn: 那瓶魔药让他重返青春。
words.en: Return to a younger state or period of life.

words.tr: phrase. 身体障碍；生理困难；体能上的困难
words.ex: She overcame her physical difficulties to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 她克服了身体上的困难赢得了比赛。
words.en: Physical difficulties refer to challenges or obstacles that are related to the body's condition or physical capabilities.

words.tr: phrase. 行走困难；步态障碍
words.ex: She has difficulty walking due to her knee injury.
words.ex_cn: 由于膝盖受伤，她行走困难。
words.en: Difficulty walking refers to the challenge or inability to walk normally, often due to physical or medical conditions.

words.ex: He solved the math problem independently.
words.ex_cn: 他独立地解决了这道数学题。
words.en: In a way that is free from outside control; not depending on another's authority.

words.ex: The children do their homework themselves.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自己做作业。
words.en: Perform an action without assistance from others.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.tr: v. 表达 (express的现在分词)；表达( express的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is expressing his feelings with simple words.
words.ex_cn: 他正用简单的词语表达自己的感受。
words.en: To convey or communicate (a thought, feeling, or idea) in words or by gestures and conduct.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树周围跑。
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于动物的。
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.ex: He is invited to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他被邀请参加聚会。
words.en: To receive an invitation to attend an event or activity.

words.ex: You will be asked to fill out a form before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 你将在面试前被要求填写一份表格。
words.en: to be requested or required to do something

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: We should talk about the plan for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该谈谈明天的计划。
words.en: To discuss or mention a particular subject.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.ex: He is hardly ever there when we need him.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要他的时候，他几乎从不在那里。
words.en: To rarely or almost never be present in a particular place or situation.

words.ex: He has a health problem and needs to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他有健康问题，需要休息。
words.en: To suffer from or be affected by a medical condition or illness.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有呼吸困难
words.ex: He has breathing difficulties after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后呼吸困难。
words.en: To experience problems with normal breathing.

words.tr: phrase. 与他人交往；与人融合；与旁人混在一起
words.ex: He likes to mix with others at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在聚会上与别人交往。
words.en: To interact and spend time with other people.

words.tr: phrase. 与他人互动；与他人交流；与他人交往
words.ex: Children learn to interact with others at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习与他人互动。
words.en: Interact with others: To communicate or engage with other people, either verbally or through non-verbal means, in social or professional settings.

words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: The box is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里装满了玩具。
words.en: To contain or hold as much or as many as possible; to be filled with something.

words.ex: The experiment is performed by the students.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验由学生们完成。
words.en: To be carried out, executed, or presented by a specific person or group.

words.ex: The test is scored by a computer.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试由电脑评分。
words.en: To be evaluated, judged, or given a mark by a particular person or system.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: The party was a celebration of her graduation.
words.ex_cn: 这个派对是她毕业的庆祝。
words.en: A celebration is a special enjoyable event that people organize because something pleasant has happened or because it is someone's birthday or anniversary.

words.tr: adj. 众所周知的；著名的
words.ex: He is a well-known singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: A well-known person, place, or thing is one that is known about by a lot of people.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.tr: phrase. 不可获得的；无法得到的；无现货的；不可用的
words.ex: The book is not available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆里没有。
words.en: If something is not available, it is not able to be used, obtained, or reached at a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭的；不营业的；停业的
words.ex: The door is closed.
words.ex_cn: 门是关着的。
words.en: To be shut or not open.

words.tr: phrase. 没有额外收费；免费；不另收费
words.ex: There is no extra charge for delivery.
words.ex_cn: 送货没有额外费用。
words.en: If there is no extra charge for something, you do not have to pay more money for it in addition to what you are already paying.

words.ex: The delivery fee is included in the cost.
words.ex_cn: 运费已包含在成本中。
words.en: To incorporate or add something to the total price or charge.

words.ex: There is an extra charge for late payment.
words.ex_cn: 迟交款项会收取额外费用。
words.en: An additional amount of money that is required to be paid for a service or product beyond the standard or advertised price.

words.tr: phrase. 额外付款；附加支付
words.ex: He made an additional payment to finish his loan.
words.ex_cn: 他额外支付了一笔钱来还清贷款。
words.en: An additional payment is an extra amount of money paid beyond what was originally agreed upon, often for additional services, overtime work, or as a penalty for delays.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.tr: 名词 一杯饮料和三明治
words.ex: He bought a drink and sandwiches for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一杯饮料和三明治当午餐。
words.en: A light meal or snack consisting of a beverage and bread filled with various ingredients.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 游泳对健康有益。
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.tr: 短语动词. 在海洋中短暂浸泡；涉足海洋
words.ex: The kids dip in the ocean for a few seconds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海洋中短暂浸泡了几秒钟。
words.en: A brief, casual experience or attempt at something new, often without deep commitment.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.tr: 从未有过；以前从未发生过
words.ex: I have never been before to this city.
words.ex_cn: 我从未去过这个城市。
words.en: To have not previously visited or experienced a specific location or situation.

words.ex: The performer danced on stage with great energy.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者在舞台上充满活力地跳舞。
words.en: A performer is a person who entertains an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.

words.tr: phrase. 演员（剧团或影视作品中的成员）
words.ex: He is a cast member of the new TV show.
words.ex_cn: 他是新电视节目的演员之一。
words.en: A member of the cast of a play or film, who has a role in the performance.

words.ex: He picked up the knife and fork and began to eat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起刀叉开始吃东西。
words.en: A knife and fork are utensils used for eating, with the knife typically used for cutting and the fork for holding or lifting food.

words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: The book is interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书很有趣。
words.en: If something is interesting, it attracts your attention, because it is unusual, exciting, or has lots of ideas.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.tr: v. 意识到；认识到；实现；
words.ex: He finally realised his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To realise means to become fully aware of something as a fact; understand clearly. It also means to achieve something desired or anticipated.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到……的；察觉到……的
words.ex_cn: 他意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To be aware of or sensitive to something.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.ex: The young kid is playing with his toy car.
words.ex_cn: 这个小男孩正在玩他的玩具车。
words.en: A young child, typically one who is not yet a teenager.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.tr: phrase. 被针对；被定位于；旨在
words.ex: The ad is targeted at children.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告针对儿童。
words.en: If something is targeted at a particular person or group, it is intended for them or directed towards them.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program is aimed at helping children read better.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助孩子更好地阅读。
words.en: If something is aimed at a particular person or group, it is intended to influence them or be of interest to them.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.tr: phrase. 在之前不；此前没有
words.ex: He did not eat before the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛之前没有吃东西。
words.en: Used to indicate that something did not happen or exist prior to a certain point in time.

words.tr: phrase. 与…作斗争；努力克服；艰难应对
words.ex: He struggles with math homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都在为数学作业发愁。
words.en: If you struggle with something, you try very hard to do it or deal with it, even though you find it difficult.

words.ex: This math problem is hard to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难解。
words.en: Difficult to; not easy to.

words.ex: I like apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.ex: This app is easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序很容易使用。
words.en: Requiring little effort to understand, operate, or handle; not complicated.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: You must have a passport to travel abroad.
words.ex_cn: 你必须拥有护照才能出国旅行。
words.en: Something that is essential or highly desirable to possess.

words.ex: What really matters is your health.
words.ex_cn: 真正重要的是你的健康。
words.en: to be of real importance or significance

words.ex: He earns 15 dollars per hour.
words.ex_cn: 他每小时赚15美元。
words.en: Used to express a rate or ratio corresponding to each hour.

words.ex: He gets paid hourly for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他按小时获得报酬。
words.en: Something that is hourly happens or is done every hour.

words.tr:
v. 穿；戴；
n. 磨损；衣着；
words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: If you wear something such as clothes, shoes, or jewellery, you have them on your body or on part of your body.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.ex: The applicant filled out the form carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位申请人仔细填写了表格。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something, especially a job.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: This rope is longer than that stick.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子比那根棍子长。
words.en: Exceeding in duration or length.

words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.ex_cn: 他有三本书以上。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.ex: The competitors ran fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 这些竞争对手在比赛中跑得很快。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.ex: The school was founded in 1990.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校成立于1990年。
