words.en: To be based on or originate from a particular source or principle.

words.ex: He walks from school to home.
words.ex_cn: 他从学校走回家。
words.en: Indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: We'll give you the book tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天把书给你。
words.en: An expression used to offer something, often as a promise or reassurance.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.tr:
n. 骑；乘坐；
v. 骑；乘坐；
words.ex: He gave me a ride on his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他让我骑了他的自行车。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal, especially a horse, or to travel in or on a vehicle or other conveyance.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.tr: phrase. 过去曾经···【动词短语】
words.ex: He used to be a teacher before he became a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他在成为医生之前是一名老师。
words.en: If something used to be a particular thing, it was that thing in the past but is not that thing now.

words.tr: adj. 关心的；有同情心的；
words.ex: She is a caring teacher who helps her students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位关心学生的老师。
words.en: If someone is caring, they are affectionate, helpful, and sympathetic.

words.ex: She is nurturing her child with love.
words.ex_cn: 她用爱养育她的孩子。
words.en: To nurture someone or something means to care for and protect them while they are growing and developing.

words.tr: adj. 合作的；协作的；共营的
words.ex: The students worked in a co-operative way to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 学生们以合作的方式完成了这个项目。
words.en: Working together with others for mutual benefit; a business or organization owned and operated by its members.

words.tr: phrase. 善于交际且自信的
words.ex: He is sociable and confident at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上外向又自信。
words.en: Comfortable in social situations and self-assured in company.

words.ex: He is an introverted boy who likes reading alone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢独自读书的内向男孩。
words.en: An introverted person is someone who tends to be more focused on their own thoughts and feelings rather than on external things or other people.

words.tr: phrase. 害羞的独行者；内向而喜欢独处的人
words.ex: He is a shy loner who rarely talks to others.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个害羞的独来独往的人，很少和别人说话。
words.en: A person or animal that is solitary and avoids contact.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: 短语动词. 自己做基本的事情；指个人能够独立完成日常生活中的简单任务
words.ex: Children should learn to do basic things for themselves, like tying their shoes.
words.ex_cn: 孩子应该学会自己做基本的事情，比如系鞋带。
words.en: To perform simple, everyday tasks without assistance from others.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.tr: phrase. 没有考虑；未将……纳入考虑范围
words.ex: He didn't take into consideration the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他没有考虑天气。
words.en: To fail to consider or include something when making a decision or plan.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 为自己辩护；维护自己的权利或立场
words.ex: She learned to stand up for herself when others were unkind.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对她不友好时，她学会了为自己辩护。
words.en: To defend oneself or one's rights; to support or protect oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 为自己辩护；保护自己
words.ex: I will defend myself if someone attacks me.
words.ex_cn: 如果有人攻击我，我会保护自己。
words.en: To protect oneself from harm or to justify one's actions or beliefs.

words.ex: My teacher is tolerant of different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对不同的观点很宽容。
words.en: If you describe someone as tolerant, you approve of the fact that they allow other people to say and do as they like, even if they do not agree with or like it.

words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.ex: The table is made from wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
words.en: Created or produced using a particular material or substance as the main component.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge takes two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建设需要两年时间。
words.en: The process of building or creating.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.tr: phrase. 被……吸引；对……产生兴趣
words.ex: He is attracted by the bright colors of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他被这幅画的鲜艳色彩吸引。
words.en: To be drawn to or interested in someone or something.

words.ex: I really like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我真的很喜欢披萨。
words.en: To have a strong liking or enjoyment for.

words.ex: He uses high-frequency words in his writing.
words.ex_cn: 他在写作中使用高频词汇。
words.en: High-frequency refers to a rate of occurrence that is high, often used in contexts such as trading, broadcasting, and medical imaging to describe rapid or rapid-fire activities or signals.

words.tr: phrase. 非常频繁的；极其常见的
words.ex: He visits his grandparents very frequently.
words.ex_cn: 他非常频繁地去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Happening or occurring often; common.

words.ex: The radio uses mid-frequency waves to send signals.
words.ex_cn: 收音机使用中频波来发送信号。
words.en: Occurring or operating at a frequency that is midway between high and low.

words.tr: phrase. 相当不那么频繁的；频率明显较低的
words.ex: Rain is rather less frequent in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天雨少得多。
words.en: Occurring with lower frequency or less often.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: The performers danced on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚演出者们在舞台上跳舞。
words.en: Performers are individuals who entertain an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.

words.ex: The orchestra and singers performed together at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 管弦乐队和歌手们在音乐会上一起表演。
words.en: The musical ensemble and vocal performers.

words.tr: phrase. 健康的食品；有益于健康的饮食
words.ex: She eats healthy food every day to stay strong.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康食品来保持强壮。
words.en: Food that is considered to be good for your health, often because it contains substances that help your body to be healthy.

words.w: food part of a healthy lifestyle
words.tr: phrase. 健康生活方式的一部分（食物）
words.uk: fuːd pɑːt əv ə ˈhɛlθi ˈlaɪfstaɪl
words.us: fuːd pɑːrt əv ə ˈhɛlθi ˈlaɪfstaɪl
words.ex: Eating vegetables is a food part of a healthy lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜是健康生活方式的一部分（食物）。
words.en: The dietary component essential for maintaining physical and mental well-being.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 占有；取得所有权；接管
words.ex: He will take possession of the new house next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下周一接收新房子。
words.en: To take control or ownership of something.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr: phrase. 组织请愿和示威活动
words.ex: Students organise petitions and demonstrations to ask for better food in the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 学生们组织请愿和示威，要求改善食堂的伙食。
words.en: To arrange and coordinate petitions and public protests.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr: v. 生长；成长；渐渐变成；种植；
words.ex: The plant grows quickly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天长得很快。
words.en: If someone or something grows, they increase in size, amount, or degree, often over a period of time.

words.w: most people have heard of him
words.uk: məʊst ˈpiːpl hæv hɪəd əv hɪm
words.us: moʊst ˈpiːpl hæv hɪrd əv hɪm
words.ex: Most people have heard of him.
words.ex_cn: 大多数人听说过他。
words.en: A person widely recognized or known by the general public.

words.tr: adj. 众所周知的；著名的
words.ex: He is a well-known singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: A well-known person, place, or thing is one that is known about by a lot of people.

words.tr: phrase. 疾病；健康状况；医学病症
words.ex: He has a medical condition that needs care.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种需要护理的疾病。
words.en: A medical condition is a broad term that includes all diseases and disorders that affect health.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: The majority of students prefer online learning.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生更喜欢在线学习。
words.en: The greater number or part; more than half of a total number or amount.

words.ex: Most of the students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority or the greater part of a group or amount.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: The math problem is difficult due to too many steps.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题因为步骤太多而很难。
words.en: Challenging because of a specific reason or circumstance.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.ex: He learned new techniques to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了新的技术来修理这台机器。
words.en: Techniques are methods or ways of doing something, especially those that require skill.

words.ex: He uses simple methods to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 被保留；被保管；被维持（keep 的被动语态）
words.ex: The food must be kept in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 食物必须被保存在冰箱里。
words.en: To be retained or preserved in a particular state or condition.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天去上学。
words.en: To move or travel to a particular place or in a particular direction.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.tr: phrase. 懂电脑；电脑操作技术
words.ex: He is computer literate and can use Excel well.
words.ex_cn: 他懂电脑，能很好地使用Excel。
words.en: Having sufficient knowledge and skill to be able to use computers and related technology efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的计算机技能
words.ex: He has good computer skill and can fix most software problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的计算机技能，能解决大多数软件问题。
words.en: Proficiency in using computers effectively.

words.tr: 短语动词. 成为团队的一员；参与团队合作
words.ex: He is part of a team that wins the match.
words.ex_cn: 他是赢得比赛的团队的一员。
words.en: To be an active and contributing member of a group working towards a common objective.

words.tr: phrase. 在团队中工作；团队协作
words.ex: They work in a team to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们团队合作完成项目。
words.en: To work in a team means to collaborate with others in a group setting to achieve a common goal.

words.ex: This thing is very useful.
words.ex_cn: 这个东西很有用。
words.en: An object, fact, affair, circumstance, or concept considered as being a separate entity.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 繁忙的；拥挤的 道路
words.ex: The busy road was full of cars during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 繁忙的道路上在高峰时段挤满了汽车。
words.en: A road with a high volume of traffic, often busy and noisy.

words.tr: phrase. 交通拥堵；繁忙的交通
words.ex: There is heavy traffic on the road after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后路上交通很拥堵。
words.en: A situation where there are so many vehicles on a road that they move very slowly or cannot move at all.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 更少的噪音；减少噪声
words.ex: The new room has less noise than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这个新房间比旧的噪音更少。
words.en: A reduction in the level of sound or disturbance.

words.ex: The library is much quieter than the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆比食堂安静得多。
words.en: Significantly lower in noise level; very quiet.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.ex: Health is the most important thing in life.
words.ex_cn: 健康是生活中最重要的事情。
words.en: Of the greatest significance or value.

words.tr: adj.最大的【形容词big的最高级】
words.ex: This is the biggest apple I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最大的苹果。
words.en: Of the greatest size or extent; largest.

words.tr: v. 伴随；陪伴；陪同；“accompany”的现在分词； adj. 伴随的；陪伴的；附随的；
words.ex: The music was accompanying her dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随着她的舞蹈。
words.en: If something is accompanying another thing, it is present or occurs with it.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.ex: He put the book at the beginning of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子的最前面。
words.en: To place something at the start or forefront.

words.ex: I wash my hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 我吃饭前洗手。
words.en: To clean something using water and usually soap.

words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.ex: She tinted the glass blue.
words.ex_cn: 她把玻璃染成了蓝色。
words.en: A tint is a small amount of a particular color, especially when it is used to make the main color lighter or darker.

words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.ex: The occurrence of rain surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 下雨这件事让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An occurrence is something that happens or takes place.

words.ex: The outbreak of the flu surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 流感的爆发让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An outbreak of something unpleasant, such as violence or a disease, is a sudden occurrence of it.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: I buy apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场买苹果。
words.en: To buy means to obtain something by paying money for it.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.tr:
v. 支付；付出代价；
n. 工资；
words.ex: He will pay for the food tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会支付饭钱。
words.en: If you pay for something which you buy or for a service which you use, you give money to the person who is selling it or providing it.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: How much is this apple?
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多少钱？
words.en: used to ask about the amount or degree of something

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.ex: There is not enough water for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 水不够所有人喝。
words.en: An expression used to indicate that the quantity or degree of something does not meet the required or desired level.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.tr: phrase. 无付款；未支付；无需付款
words.ex: There is no payment for this service.
words.ex_cn: 这项服务不需要付款。
words.en: The absence of payment for goods or services.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.tr: phrase. 保持冷冻；需冷冻保存
words.ex: Keep the ice cream frozen in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 把冰淇淋放在冰箱里保持冷冻。
words.en: To maintain something at a very low temperature to prevent spoilage.

words.tr: phrase. 不融化；不熔化；保持固态
words.ex: The ice cream does not melt in the cold box.
words.ex_cn: 冰淇淋在冷箱里不会融化。
words.en: To remain solid and not change to liquid, especially under heat.

words.tr: phrase. 商业的业务；商业活动；指以盈利为目的的企业或贸易行为
words.ex: He runs a small commercial business selling books.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小型商业企业，出售书籍。
words.en: An organization or activity that buys and sells goods or services for money.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理了那些旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something means to get rid of it, especially by throwing it away.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: The dark clouds are an indication of rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云是下雨的迹象。
words.en: An indication is a sign which suggests, for example, what people are thinking or feeling.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: I like apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的；一流的；处于领导地位的； v. “lead”的现在分词；带领；领导；
words.ex: He is the leading scientist in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家。
words.en: If something is leading in a particular area, it is the most important or advanced thing in that area.

words.tr: phrase. 最先进的；最高级的；最发达的
words.ex: This is the most advanced computer in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 这是实验室里最先进的电脑。
words.en: The most technologically or intellectually developed; at the forefront of progress.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.tr: v. 改善；改进；“improve”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 改良的；改进的；
words.ex: He improved his English by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习改善了自己的英语。
words.en: If something improves or if you improve it, it gets better.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr:
v. 建筑；建造；逐步加强；
n. 体格；体形；
words.ex: They build a house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们在湖边建了一所房子。
words.en: To construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He is the tallest boy in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最高的男孩。
words.en: The superlative form of 'tall', meaning having the greatest height among others.

words.ex: He got the highest score in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在班上得了最高分。
words.en: Of the most elevated position or degree; utmost.

words.tr: v. 发现；找到；建立；认为；“find”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He found a strange stone on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一块奇怪的石头。
words.en: To establish or set up (an organization, institution, or place) on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: He worked hard in the first five years.
words.ex_cn: 他在头五年努力工作。
words.en: The initial period of five years from a starting point.

words.tr: phrase. 研究资料；研究来源；用于学术研究的文献或信息出处
words.ex: He found good research sources in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆找到了好的研究资料。
words.en: Research sources are materials, documents, or data used to gather information for study, investigation, or academic work.

words.tr: 书籍和网站的详细信息
words.ex: She wrote down the details of books and websites for her project.
words.ex_cn: 她把书籍和网站的详细信息记了下来，用于她的项目。
words.en: Information concerning publications and online resources.

words.tr: phrase. 不那么具体的；较笼统的；更含糊的
words.ex: His answer was less specific than hers.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不如她的具体。
words.en: Less precise or detailed; not providing as much specific information.

words.tr: phrase. 不太精确的；不够准确的
words.ex: The answer is not too precise.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案不够精确。
words.en: Not very accurate or exact.

words.tr: phrase. 潜在威胁；可能性威胁
words.ex: The new virus is considered a potential threat to public health.
words.ex_cn: 这种新病毒被认为是对公共健康的潜在威胁。
words.en: A potential threat is something that could possibly cause harm or danger in the future, but has not done so yet.

words.tr: phrase. 可能发生的危险；潜在危险
words.ex: There is a possible danger of falling rocks.
words.ex_cn: 有落石的可能危险。
words.en: The possibility or likelihood of harm or risk.

words.tr: phrase. 快速的移动；迅速的动作
words.ex: The cat made a fast movement across the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫快速地穿过房间。
words.en: Movement at a high speed.

words.tr: phrase. 快速运动；迅速移动
words.ex: The car moved in rapid motion down the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车沿着道路快速行驶。
words.en: Quick movement or action.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.ex: He has a confused attitude about the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对这些规则感到困惑。
words.en: A state of uncertainty or lack of clarity.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: The continuity of the story made it easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的连续性让它容易理解。
words.en: Continuity is the fact that something continues to happen or exist, with no great changes or interruptions.

words.tr: phrase. 永无止境的循环；周而复始的循环
words.ex: He is stuck in a never-ending cycle of working and sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 他陷入了一个不断工作和睡觉的循环中。
words.en: A situation or process that seems to continue without ever stopping or reaching an end.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.tr: phrase. 未受伤的；没有疼痛的（用于表示身体或情感上未受伤害）
words.ex: The child is not hurt after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子摔倒后未受伤。
words.en: Not causing physical or emotional pain; unharmed.

words.tr: adv. 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: Surprisingly, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 令人惊讶的是，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: In a manner that causes surprise because it is unexpected or unusual.

words.ex: He solved the problem amazingly fast.
words.ex_cn: 他令人惊讶地快速解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that causes great surprise or wonder.

words.tr: phrase. 闻名的；众所周知的
words.ex: He is well known in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他在他的城镇里很有名。
words.en: If someone or something is well known, they are known about by a lot of people.

words.ex: He is a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: Known about by many people.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: She will organise a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将组织一次会议。
words.en: To organise means to arrange or plan something systematically, especially events or activities.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.ex: He answered the question correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: In a manner that is accurate and free from errors.

words.ex: You must clean the room properly.
words.ex_cn: 你必须正确地打扫房间。
words.en: If something is done properly, it is done in a correct and satisfactory way.

words.tr: v. 完成；“complete”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 完整的；已完成的；
words.ex: He completed his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: Having all necessary or normal parts, components, or steps; fully carried out or accomplished.

words.tr: v. 完成；“do”的过去分词； adj. 已完成的；
words.ex: I done my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我完成了我的作业。
words.en: If something is done, it has been completed or finished.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.tr:
n. 长队；
v. 排队；
words.ex: There is a long queue at the ticket counter.
words.ex_cn: 售票处排着一条长队。
words.en: A queue is a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.tr: adj. 现存的； v. 存在；“exist”的现在分词；
words.ex: The existing rules need to be changed.
words.ex_cn: 现有的规则需要更改。
words.en: Existing is used to describe something that is present or available now.

words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.ex: He walks to school each day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行去上学。
words.en: Every day; on a daily basis.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助制定计划；协助规划
words.ex: He helps to plan the school trip.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙计划学校旅行。
words.en: To assist in organizing or arranging something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出建议；给出建议
words.ex: He makes suggestions during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出建议。
words.en: To propose ideas or recommendations.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 不含肉类或鱼类的
words.ex: He eats no meat or fish.
words.ex_cn: 他不吃肉也不吃鱼。
words.en: Describing food that contains no animal flesh.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr: v. 表现；行动；“act”的现在分词； n. 演戏；演技；
words.ex: He is acting bravely in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中表现得很勇敢。
words.en: Acting is the activity or profession of performing in plays, films, or television productions.

words.tr: adj. 迷惑的；混乱的； v. 迷惑；混淆；“confuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He looked confused when the teacher asked the question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他看起来很迷惑。
words.en: If you are confused, you do not know exactly what is happening or what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 混淆的；困惑的；混乱的；卷入纠纷的
words.ex: I got mixed up with the dates.
words.ex_cn: 我把日期搞混了。
words.en: Confused or mistaken; to combine things incorrectly or to be in a state of disorder.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.ex: It's a coincidence that we both wore blue today.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天都穿了蓝色，真是巧合。
words.en: A coincidence is when two or more similar or related events occur at the same time by chance and without any planning.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella today.
words.ex_cn: 今天带伞是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and often that it may be harmful or undesirable.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.ex: He stayed home because of illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: An illness is a particular disease, especially one that is not very serious.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.tr: phrase. 无障碍；无阻碍；没有壁垒
words.ex: There are no barriers to learning English.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语没有任何障碍。
words.en: No obstacles or restrictions preventing something from happening.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.tr: adj. 较大的；程度较重的；
words.ex: This box is greater than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: You use greater to indicate that something is larger in size, degree, or importance than something else.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: He used up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的水都用完了。
words.en: To consume or exhaust something completely.

words.ex: The wood burns slowly in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 木头在火中缓慢燃烧。
words.en: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that there is a burn there. When you burn something, you destroy or damage it with fire or heat.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.ex: I have to go to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天必须去上学。
words.en: If you have to do something, it is necessary for you to do it.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.tr: phrase. 极其不愉快的；非常讨厌的
words.ex: The smell was extremely unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 那气味非常难闻。
words.en: used to describe something that is very disagreeable or offensive

words.tr: phrase. 高强度工作；密集型劳动；需要高度集中精力的工作
words.ex: He did intensive work to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了密集的工作以按时完成项目。
words.en: Intensive work refers to work that is done with a lot of effort and concentration, often over a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 努力工作；勤奋劳动
words.ex: He work hard every day to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力工作来攒钱。
words.en: To put a lot of effort into one's job or a task.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr: phrase. 在该地区；在……区域内；大约；接近
words.ex: The birds live in the region near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在湖附近地区。
words.en: In or around a particular area or place; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的样本；大量的样品
words.ex: The scientist tested a large sample of water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自这条河的大批水样。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.tr: phrase. 难以理解的；不容易明白的
words.ex: This math problem is hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难理解。
words.en: Difficult to comprehend or interpret.

words.tr: adj. 令人费解的；使人困惑的； v. 混淆；“confuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The instructions are confusing.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明令人费解。
words.en: If something is confusing, it is difficult to understand because it is not clear or is complicated.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.ex: I saw him two days ago.
words.ex_cn: 我两天前见过他。
words.en: If something happened a particular length of time ago, it is that length of time since it happened.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.ex: My parents give support when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的父母给予支持。
words.en: To help or encourage someone or something.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.ex: The park has many quiet areas for reading.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园有许多安静的区域可以读书。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a town, a country, a region, or the world.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: phrase. 对...的关心；对...表示忧虑
words.ex: Parents have concern about their child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 父母对孩子的安全感到担心。
words.en: If you concern about something, you feel worried about it.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.ex: The reduction in cost helped the company save money.
words.ex_cn: 成本的减少帮助公司节省了资金。
words.en: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc., or the result of this.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在不久的将来；在最近的未来
words.ex: He will start his new job in the immediate future.
words.ex_cn: 他将在不久的将来开始他的新工作。
words.en: In the very near future; soon.

words.ex: He will shortly be leaving for Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他不久将前往日本。
words.en: Will soon be; will happen in the near future.

words.ex: What does matter is that you try your best.
words.ex_cn: 重要的是你尽了最大努力。
words.en: The most important thing is.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.tr: phrase. 发起一场大规模的宣传活动
words.ex: The company have a big publicity campaign to launch their new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在进行一场大规模的宣传活动来推出他们的新手机。
words.en: To carry out an extensive promotional effort.

words.ex: The campaign aims to raise public awareness about clean water.
words.ex_cn: 这个活动旨在提高公众对清洁用水的意识。
words.en: To increase the general public's knowledge or understanding of a particular issue or subject.

words.ex: They decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone something means to arrange for it to take place at a later time than was originally planned.

words.tr: phrase. 暂缓；搁置；暂停处理；使等待
words.ex: The project is put on hold until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目被暂停到下个月。
words.en: To postpone or delay something.

words.tr:
n. 通知；公告；
v. 注意到；
words.ex: The school sent notices to parents about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校向家长发送了关于假期的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.ex: The road has many signs for directions.
words.ex_cn: 这条路有很多方向标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. Signs can also be gestures or movements that you make with your hands or head to give someone information, instructions, or a warning. In addition, a sign can be an event, fact, or situation that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.ex: Good planning helps him finish work on time.
words.ex_cn: 良好的计划帮助他按时完成工作。
words.en: The act of organizing something effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 设计精良的；构思良好的
words.ex: The house is well designed for families.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子为家庭设计得很好。
words.en: Something that is well designed is made in a way that is clever and effective, and usually looks good.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr: v. 生长；成长；渐渐变成；种植；
words.ex: The plant grows quickly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天长得很快。
words.en: If someone or something grows, they increase in size, amount, or degree, often over a period of time.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.tr: phrase. 不再存在；已消失；已灭绝
words.ex: The old temple no longer exists.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙已经不存在了。
words.en: To have ceased to exist or be present.

words.ex: The bird lost the ability to fly after its wing was hurt.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟的翅膀受伤后，失去了飞行的能力。
words.en: To become unable to fly.

words.ex: The kiwi is a flightless bird.
words.ex_cn: 几维鸟是一种不会飞的鸟。
words.en: Flightless birds are birds that through evolution lost the ability to fly.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: They stock up on rice before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们在风暴来临前囤积大米。
words.en: To accumulate a large quantity of something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.tr:
adv. 迅速；
adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.tr: phrase. 步行前往；走到（某地）
words.ex: He walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: To travel on foot to a place.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 参与；参加（活动、事件等）
words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in something means to be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.ex: He came close to winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 他差点就赢了比赛。
words.en: To come close to something means to almost reach or achieve it, or to be very similar to it.

words.ex: A cat popped up in front of me while I was walking.
words.ex_cn: 我走路时，一只猫突然出现在我面前。
words.en: To appear suddenly in front of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.ex: Can you explain this math problem?
words.ex_cn: 你能解释一下这个数学问题吗？
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.ex: We should talk about the plan for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该谈谈明天的计划。
words.en: To discuss or mention a particular subject.
To feel happy or satisfied about something.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr: phrase. 特别需要的；专门要求的
words.ex: This tool is specially needed for disabled students.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是为残障学生特别需要的。
words.en: Required in a specific or exceptional way.

words.tr: phrase. 特别地；尤其需要；格外要求
words.ex: This job particularly requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作特别需要耐心。
words.en: To need or demand something to a notable degree.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: adj. 更容易的；更简单的；“easy”的比较级；
words.ex: This math problem is easier than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题比上一个更容易。
words.en: comparative form of easy: less difficult or requiring less effort.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.tr: v. 期待；期望；预期；“expect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 预料的；预期的；
words.ex: I expected him to arrive early.
words.ex_cn: 我期待他早点到。
words.en: If you say that something is expected, you mean that people think that it will happen or that it is true.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.tr: v. 使留下深刻印象；使铭记；
words.ex: His speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲给在场的每个人留下了深刻印象。
words.en: If someone or something impresses you, you feel great admiration for them.

words.tr: phrase. 原以为他们会知道（thought 是 think 的过去式，they'd 是 they would 的缩写）
words.ex: They thought they'd know the answer, but they were wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他们以为他们会知道答案，但他们错了。
words.en: Believed someone would have knowledge or information.

words.ex: Little is known about how the ancient machine worked.
words.ex_cn: 关于这台古代机器是如何工作的，人们知之甚少。
words.en: Very little information is available about.

words.tr: phrase. 不太了解；知道得不多
words.ex: I don't know much about math.
words.ex_cn: 我对数学不太了解。
words.en: Have limited knowledge about something.

words.ex: He wants to do further study after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他想在毕业后继续深造。
words.en: Additional research or learning undertaken to deepen knowledge or understanding in a particular area.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.tr: phrase. 找到方法；设法做到
words.ex: He couldn't find way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找不到解决这个问题的方法。
words.en: To discover a method or means to achieve something.

words.ex: The formula is derived from simple math rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个公式是从简单的数学规则推导出来的。
words.en: If you say that something is derived from something else, you mean that it comes from that thing.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我感觉明天会下雨。
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.ex: He found early examples of writing on ancient stones.
words.ex_cn: 他在古老的石头上发现了早期的书写例子。
words.en: Initial or first instances of something.

words.ex: This stone tablet is the earliest example of writing.
words.ex_cn: 这块石碑是最早的书写例子。
words.en: The very first instance of something.

words.ex: The ancient temple has beautiful stone carvings.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有精美的石刻。
words.en: Carvings are objects or designs that have been cut out of a material such as wood or stone, often as a form of artistic expression.

words.tr: v. 雕刻；切开；“carve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He carved a bird on the wooden box.
words.ex_cn: 他在木盒上雕刻了一只鸟。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: The greeks built many temples long ago.
words.ex_cn: 希腊人很久以前建造了许多神庙。
words.en: The Greeks are the people of Greece, a country in southeastern Europe. The Greek language is also referred to as Greek.

words.ex: He visited Greece last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了希腊。
words.en: Greece is a country in southeastern Europe with thousands of islands throughout the Aegean and Ionian seas. It's often called the cradle of Western civilization, and Athens, its capital, retains landmarks including the 5th-century B.C. Acropolis citadel with the Parthenon temple.

words.ex: He is a big boy now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在是个大男孩了。
words.en: Of considerable size or extent; larger than other items of its kind.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.tr: n. 利益；好处；“benefit”的复数； v. 有益于；有助于；
words.ex: The benefits of exercise are clear.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼的好处是显而易见的。
words.en: Benefits are advantages or profits that you get from something, especially advantages that you get from the government or from your employer, such as money or health insurance.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: The slower car reached the finish line last.
words.ex_cn: 那辆更慢的车最后到达了终点。
words.en: Moving or happening at a lower speed than something else.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.tr: phrase. 从…中解脱；从…中缓解；免除
words.ex: The medicine brought relief from his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief from refers to the act of lessening or freeing someone from pain, distress, or oppression.

words.ex: Can you help with my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我做作业吗？
words.en: To provide assistance or support with a task.

words.ex: He got involved in the school play last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To become a part of or participate in an activity or situation.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.
To accompany someone to a place, often by vehicle.

words.tr: phrase. 一种搭载；搭便车（指提供交通工具运送某人）
words.ex: He gave me a lift to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他搭我去了车站。
words.en: A ride in a vehicle to a destination.

words.tr: phrase. 做出改变；进行修改；作出调整
words.ex: He makes changes to his schedule every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都会更改自己的日程。
words.en: To alter or modify something in order to achieve a different result or to adapt to new conditions.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: They will demolish the old building next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会拆掉那座旧建筑。
words.en: To demolish something such as a building means to destroy it completely. It can also mean to defeat someone completely in a discussion, argument, or competition.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: The hotel has many clean rooms.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有许多干净的房间。
words.en: Rooms refer to the spaces within a building that are separated by walls, floors, and ceilings, used for living, working, or storage.

words.ex: Artists and writers often work in quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家和作家经常在安静的地方工作。
words.en: Individuals engaged in creative professions involving visual arts, literature, or other forms of artistic expression.

words.ex: Painters and poets create beauty with color and words.
words.ex_cn: 画家和诗人用色彩和文字创造美。
words.en: Artists who create visual works and writers of poetry.

words.tr: phrase. 穿着戏服；化装打扮
words.ex: She went to the party in costume as a pirate.
words.ex_cn: 她装扮成海盗去参加派对。
words.en: Wearing a costume or dressed in a particular outfit, often for a performance, party, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.tr:
n. 微型汽车；
adj. 微型的；迷你的；
words.ex: He drives a mini to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开一辆微型汽车去上班。
words.en: Mini is used to describe something which is very small, especially a smaller version of something which is usually larger.

words.ex: The toy is child-sized and perfect for small hands.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具是儿童尺寸的，非常适合小手玩耍。
words.en: Suitable in size for a child.

words.tr: phrase. 农业设备；农用机械
words.ex: He uses farming equipment to plant crops.
words.ex_cn: 他使用农具种植庄稼。
words.en: Machinery used in farming or agriculture.

words.tr: phrase. 农业工具；用于耕作和农作物生产的器械
words.ex: Farmers use agricultural tools to plant crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用农具种植庄稼。
words.en: Tools used in farming to increase efficiency and productivity.

words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.ex: He played soccer in the past.
words.ex_cn: 他过去踢足球。
words.en: At a time before the present; in earlier times.

words.ex: The children love to see animals at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在动物园看动物。
words.en: Animals are living creatures such as dogs, lions, and dolphins. They are not plants, and they can usually move around and react to their surroundings.

words.ex: Donkeys and horses live together on the farm.
words.ex_cn: 驴和马一起住在农场里。
words.en: Equine animals, including donkeys and horses, often used for transport or labor.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.tr: phrase. 保持清洁；保持干净
words.ex: We must keep clean the classroom every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须每天保持教室清洁。
words.en: To maintain a state of cleanliness.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.ex: She buys gifts for her friends at Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 她在圣诞节为朋友们买礼物。
words.en: To purchase presents or items intended as gifts for others.

words.ex: I read three books last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周读了三本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎从未被发现的；极难找到的
words.ex: Rare birds are hardly ever found in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 稀有鸟类在这片森林里几乎从不被发现。
words.en: To be extremely rare or almost non-existent in a specific context or location.

words.ex: His reaction was quick when the ball came at him.
words.ex_cn: 当球朝他飞来时，他的反应很快。
words.en: Your reaction to something that has happened or something that you have experienced is what you feel, say, or do because of it.

words.tr: phrase. 情感影响；情绪冲击
words.ex: The movie had a strong emotional impact on her.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对她产生了强烈的情感影响。
words.en: The effect or influence that an event, situation, or person has on someone's feelings.

words.ex: The movie has many exciting scenes.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有很多激动人心的场景。
words.en: Scenes refer to the places where events or actions occur, or the views or sights that can be seen in a particular place.

words.ex: He only understood bits of the story.
words.ex_cn: 他只理解了这个故事的一部分。
words.en: A bit is a small piece or amount of something, or the smallest unit of information in a computer.

words.tr: phrase. 主要优势；主要力量
words.ex: Her major strength is solving math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 她的主要优势是快速解决数学问题。
words.en: A major strength refers to a significant advantage or the most powerful aspect of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 最令人难忘的事物
words.ex: The most memorable thing was my first trip to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 最难忘的事情是我第一次去海边。
words.en: The most striking or unforgettable element or aspect of an experience.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
